B. Braun provides a vast range of healthcare items across clinical, surgical, and pharmaceutical sectors. Their main offerings include intravenous and infusion therapy systems, surgical instruments, sutures, and blood treatment devices. You can view the full line using the official [B. Braun Standard Product Catalog](https://catalogs.bbraun.com/en-01/c/PRODUCTS/b-braun-standard-product-catalog).

- **Introcan Safety® 3**: Safety IV catheters featuring blood control technology.

- **Ecoflac® plus**: Closed IV container and soft bottle systems.

- **Compactplus & Space**: Infusion pumps and automated systems for accurate medication delivery.

- **Intrafix®**: Administration and infusion sets.

- **Injekt® & Omnifix®**: Disposable syringes and needles. [](https://catalogs.bbraun.com/en-01/c/PRODUCTS0000000523/infusion)

### Surgery and Instruments (Aesculap Division)

- **Surgical Instruments**: Reusable hand-held tools like scalpels, forceps, scissors, and retractors.

- **Surgical Power Systems**: Motor systems for bone and tissue cutting.

- **Sutures & Specialties**: Surgical threads, tissue adhesives, meshes, and hemostats.

- **Sterile Container Systems**: Storage and wrapping solutions for safe instrument sterilization. [](https://catalogs.bbraun.com/en-01/c/PRODUCTS/b-braun-standard-product-catalog)

### Clinical Nutrition and IV Drugs

- **Nutriflex®**: Multi-chamber parenteral nutrition bags.

- **Aminoplasmal®**: Amino acid solutions.

- **Base Solutions**: Saline and glucose intravenous infusion solutions (like normal saline and Ringer's lactate).

### Renal and Blood Treatments

- **Diapact®**: Systems for continuous renal replacement therapy (CRRT).

- **Extracorporeal Circuits**: Blood lines and dialyzers for blood purification therapies. [](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/B._Braun)
